title: game/lessons/<id>.json
description: One lesson (C06: one file each; game/lessons.json lists them in order): a list of steps of seven types, so a new lesson needs no code. Loaded by LessonBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core), which also checks the phrases, prompts, speech lines, NPCs and world events named here. The text is the locale's (lesson.<id>.*).

id.description: A stable id (first-words), the file's name; saves name it.

npc.description: The NPC the lesson starts at.

autoStart.description: The lesson starts when the player first talks to its NPC.

after.description: An earlier lesson of the file this one follows.

session.description: The play session it unlocks in (default 1); above 1 the locale needs its objective line (lesson.<id>.objective).

verbs.description: The verb forms the lesson teaches (the book's tables).

npc.description: An NPC by its agent id (agents/<id>.json): guide, shopkeeper, villager.

id.description: Unique within the lesson; saves name it.

attempts.description: How many tries before the step moves on (default 2).

npc.description: The NPC the step is said at, when the lesson moves from one NPC to another.

line.description: model, listen, answer: a speech line id (phrase.hola, guide.lesson.hello.1).

correct.description: listen: the index of the right option (the options are the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.option.<n>).

phrase.description: repeat, answer: a phrase-sheet row the learner says.

prompt.description: repeat, answer: the bundle prompt the answer is evaluated at (default: the row's).

person.description: repeat, answer: the person of the verb the step expects (its retry line is the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.personRetry).

tense.description: repeat, answer: the tense the step expects (its retry line is the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.tenseRetry).

point.description: do: a noun the beacon points at when the step begins (the step's HUD line is the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.hud).

phrases.description: recap: the phrases listed (default: every phrase the lesson teaches).

trigger.description: do: the world event the step waits for, with the npc and the exact detail it must have (C06).

step.$comment: Each rule of allOf reads: when the type is one of these, these fields are required (an implication, written with anyOf and not so that every validator reads it).

event.description: The event waited for: a world event (WorldEvents), or for a tip start or aimed_npc.

npc.description: The NPC the event must be about (an agent id).

detail.description: The detail the event must have, exactly (item_picked_up: the noun; torch_at_ring: the ring's name).

trigger.description: What the step or tip waits for (CONTENT_PLAN C06).
